description: The second DEBUG method (S14 T3): the daemon's goroutine stacks, so `aeon debug goroutines | grep -c agentsvc` answering 0 can be SHOWN — an async Task is a suspension (AS4/P2), and the stacks are the evidence. Debug-marked so S19's narrowed surface excludes it: goroutine dumps on a public surface are an information leak by another name.
